title: Alex Miller
content:
![me.jpg](/post-images/18d5c4502c4bcb73.jpg)


Founder, investor, and operator backing early-stage startups from Japan to Bangladesh — 60+ companies backed, with a 100% follow-on fundraising track record.


Currently a partner at ZEPH ([zeph.vc](http://zeph.vc/)), an energy-transition investment platform based in Dhaka. ZEPH backs founders solving Bangladesh's energy crisis from early stage to Series A across three arms: ZEPH Ventures (equity), ZEPH Capital (founder-friendly working capital, so companies can buy the solar, batteries, and fleets without burning equity), and ZEPH Energy (a China supply-chain conduit that lets Bangladeshi companies build at a Chinese cost base). Diligence happens on the ground — walking the depot, meeting the team, in Mandarin when it counts.


Also building ClimateFair, ZEPH's open "Requests for Climate Startups" — a public idea bank and the inbound funnel for the businesses the fund most wants built — and AimHuge, an AI workshops and advisory practice (and the agent tooling behind it) that helps operators build faster, because for the first time hardware moves like software.


Previously founded [ChatCenter.ai](http://chatcenter.ai/), led AI-driven ad tech as Head of Product at ReFUEL4, scaled marketing marketplace GetCraft as CTO, and helped take [Renren.com](http://renren.com/) to IPO. Early adopter of AI and blockchain (since 2010 & 2012), with deep expertise in engineering, data science, and full-stack development (JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js).


Now focused on the energy transition in South Asia and practical founder education — from pitch decks to cofounder breakups.
